name: @voltui/cli
description: CLI that copies accessible Volt UI Angular components into your project (shadcn-style copy-and-own, built on ng-primitives and Tailwind CSS v4).

scripts.pack:registry: node prepare-package.js && npm pack --dry-run && node prepare-package.js --clean
scripts.publish:registry: node prepare-package.js && npm publish --access public && node prepare-package.js --clean

author: Andersseen
